title: Why the Sahara’s Sand Can ‘Sing’ at Night

scenes.text: Ever heard the Sahara dunes hum after sunset?
When sand grains are perfectly round and dry, they can rub together and create audible tones.
scenes.label: ROUND DRY SAND
scenes.query: singing sand dunes round dry sand

scenes.text: The sound is amplified by the dune’s shape, acting like a natural resonating chamber.
scenes.label: DUNE RESONANCE

scenes.text: Scientists have recorded frequencies from a low hum up to a high‑pitched squeak, depending on grain size.
scenes.label: FREQUENCY RANGE

scenes.text: Follow if you love learning something new.

description: The Sahara hides a musical secret that only reveals itself after dark. Discover how tiny grains become a natural instrument. Follow for more unheard wonders!
